pages.title: Two distinct thresholds
pages.text:
Two distinct thresholds
The 8 mg threshold deﬁnes the actual scientiﬁc outcome.
The 0.5 score threshold deﬁnes
the decision rule. Moving the second threshold changes false-positive and false-negative
counts without changing the measured labels.

pages.title: Evaluation after fitting
pages.text:
Evaluation after ﬁtting
Fit scaling, regression, classiﬁcation, projection and cluster centers using training data.
Evaluate each operation on the held-out experiment using its own stated target. Do not
select the best-looking method from repeated test-set inspection.
